name: Kubernetes Security Assessment
description: Security assessment of Kubernetes clusters and workloads. Covers RBAC, network policies, Pod Security Standards enforced via Pod Security Admission (PodSecurityPolicy was removed in v1.25), secrets management, admission controllers, service mesh, API server security, and Kubernetes-specific attack paths including privilege escalation and lateral movement.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to Kubernetes security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands Kubernetes architecture, RBAC model, and common security concerns
evidence: Can explain Kubernetes components (API server, kubelet, etcd, scheduler)
Understands RBAC roles, bindings, and service accounts
Familiar with Kubernetes threat model and common attack patterns

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews Kubernetes configurations under supervision using established tools
evidence: Runs Kubernetes security tools (e.g., kube-bench, Kubescape) under guidance
Identifies overly permissive RBAC bindings and pod security violations using checklists
Documents Kubernetes security findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses Kubernetes cluster security and identifies attack paths
evidence: Independently enumerates and reviews RBAC configurations, network policies, and pod security
Identifies privilege escalation paths through RBAC, pod specs, and node access
Evaluates secrets management and admission controller effectiveness
Produces compliant Kubernetes security assessment reports

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex multi-cluster assessments; develops exploitation tooling; mentors others
evidence: Assesses complex multi-cluster environments with service mesh and custom operators
Develops tooling for automated Kubernetes RBAC analysis and attack path discovery
Reviews Kubernetes assessment work of junior analysts
Demonstrates advanced exploitation (node compromise, etcd access, API server abuse)

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab Kubernetes assessment methodology; publishes Kubernetes security research
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's Kubernetes security assessment framework
Published research on novel Kubernetes attack techniques or admission controller bypasses
Trains teams on advanced Kubernetes security assessment
Recognized as authority on Kubernetes security

assessment_methods.description: Assess a deliberately misconfigured Kubernetes cluster and identify all privilege escalation and lateral movement paths
Given a Kubernetes RBAC configuration and pod specs, identify all paths from unprivileged pod to cluster-admin
